title: Fleet overview
description: Compare monitored hosts at a glance. Offline hosts remain visible in exporter status; resource charts show only hosts that are reporting. SMART coverage counts are not a substitute for drive health checks.

panels.title: Host reachability
panels.description: Node exporter reachability. An offline workstation remains Down rather than being counted as healthy.

panels.title: Unreadable SMART drives
panels.description: Discovered drives without readable SMART data, per reporting host. This can detect an exporter that is Up but cannot read its devices. Select a host in SMART disks for details.

targets.expr: smartctl_devices{job="smartctl"} - on(host,instance) (count by(host,instance) (smartctl_device{job="smartctl"}) or on(host,instance) (0 * smartctl_devices{job="smartctl"}))

panels.title: RAM use by host
panels.description: Excludes reclaimable memory, based on MemAvailable.

panels.title: Root filesystem use by host
panels.description: Space on each host's root filesystem. Other filesystems and ZFS pools have separate dashboards.

panels.title: Reboot required
panels.description: The active kernel, initrd, or kernel modules differ from the booted ones. Each host updates the value when it activates a system.

panels.title: Deployed revision
panels.description: Commit of this repository that built the active system of each reporting host. Dirty means that the checkout had uncommitted changes at the switch, so the system can differ from the commit. On main compares the commit with the newest main commit that the cache host resolved. It is Unknown when the cache host has not resolved main in the last 30 minutes.

targets.expr: (((nixos_configuration_revision_info{job="node"} * on(revision) group_left() nix_cache_main_revision_info{job="node"}) or (0 * nixos_configuration_revision_info{job="node"})) and on() (time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{job="node",file="/var/lib/nix-cache-prebuild/main.prom"} < 1800)) or (-1 * nixos_configuration_revision_info{job="node"})

panels.title: Cache host update services
panels.description: Whether a service that updates the flake inputs or prebuilds the workstations failed in the last 30 minutes. A failed build or push fails the service. nix-cache-update runs daily, and the other two run every 10 minutes. No data means that systemd has not loaded the service since startup.

panels.title: Last cache host update start
panels.description: Last trigger time that systemd reports for each timer. This is a start time, not a completion time. A run that finds nothing new also counts.
